svg.title: Training, validation and test data for choosing a penalty weight
svg.desc: Panel A uses one training-validation split and reserves a separate test set. Panel B uses the same five groups in every row, with each group used once for validation and the other four for fitting. For each lambda, refit the weights in every row and average the validation errors. For both approaches, keep the chosen lambda fixed and refit weights using all training and validation observations before evaluating on the test set. The test set is outside all folds and is used for final evaluation only.

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #c3c9cd; stroke-width: 0.7; stroke-linecap: square
